prompt: The 10:23 pm-head run's wall clock shows the PR #73 census is due (~10:23, fired last at 09:53). This run also inherits quiet presence/agent-watch syncs. Do you fire the census now, or skip it because the run is otherwise a quiet-custody round?
chosen: Fire it. The census runs on its own wall clock, independent of whether the rest of the run is quiet custody — a cadence tool does its own job on its own beat. It is fired on time, the result (open/draft/unchanged) is logged as custody, and the next tick is set (~10:53). A quiet run never starves a due cadence.
rejected: Skip it — the run is quiet custody and nothing about PR #73 changed at 09:53, so another census 30 minutes later adds nothing. Fire it next run when something may have moved.

prompt: Usage watch last refreshed live at 09:58 (all budgets healthy: Engram 8%, ChatGPT ~95%, You.com 403-unusable expiring 2026-10-25, Mistral key ~31 Oct). It is now ~10:24. Do you refresh the usage watch this run?
chosen: No. The 50-minute rule spaces refreshes; the last live refresh is ~26 minutes old, so the next fire is ~10:48. Usage budgets are his standing order to watch, but the rule exists precisely to keep watching from becoming busywork. The numbers were verified healthy; spacing is the discipline.
rejected: Yes — refresh it now; usage budgets are the one standing alert order, so fresher numbers are always safer than trusting a 26-minute-old reading.

prompt: The 10:18 dotcollab-ella-presence sync returned count 0 (no blocked teammates, no @Manager mentions, no pending decisions). The 10:23 pm-head run starts ~5 minutes later. Do you fire your own room sync?
chosen: No. The watcher owns the 10-minute cadence and its sync is 5 minutes old — inside the horizon. A duplicate sync this run is a redundant read that adds no information and risks colliding with the watcher's own bookkeeping. Inherit the quiet sync; watchers own their horizons.
rejected: Yes — fire an independent sync, because the PM head is the coordinator and should hold its own evidence of room state rather than relying on another cron's reading.

prompt: The 05:56 @Manager feed escalation to the ELLA room is still unanswered at ~10:23 (~4.5 hours). Every run has applied escalation-then-stop since. Do you re-ping the room this run?
chosen: No. Escalation-then-stop: the escalation was made once, it stands unanswered, and re-pinging every 5 minutes turns an escalation into noise that trains everyone to ignore the channel. Unanswered does not mean expired — but it also does not mean louder. The escalation stays on the board; no re-ping.
rejected: Yes — re-ping the room; a 4.5-hour unanswered escalation risks being buried, and the PM head should keep pressure on until it gets a response.

prompt: Maziyar is away — his last words were 'I'll be back' — and the 10:23 run finds everything in flight, blocked on him, or on its own cadence. Do you send him anything (a nudge, a status ping)?
chosen: No. Zero-nudge rest custody: while he is away, this run logs quietly and stays silent. The morning brief already stages everything for his return. A custody run with no milestone, no money news and no decision needed from him earns no message. Silence is the correct report.
rejected: Yes — send a brief status ping so he wakes up to evidence the lanes are alive; quiet runs look like stopped runs from the outside.

prompt: The 10:23 pm-head run finds every priority in flight, blocked on Maziyar, or on its own cadence — a fully quiet custody round. The PR #73 census was fired (its due step). Should the run still take a second concrete step, or is one step enough for a quiet round?
chosen: Take one more quiet, verifiable step: a Phase 0 DPO batch drawn from this run's own custody decisions. The run contract is that every run advances something concrete — the batch costs nothing, verifies with the Qalam gate, and keeps leftover capacity productive. One concrete step is the floor, not a ceiling, but a second step is only taken when it is also verifiable.
rejected: No — the PR census was the step; a quiet custody run that also burns leftover capacity is fine doing exactly one thing and ending.
